subject: Remit split rulebook + collector checklist — partial payment allocation across entities/cost centers
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana@novushealth.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, AR <ar@novushealth.io>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partial payment for invoice 4359 — routing across Novus entities

Hi Jordan / Redwood billing team,

We posted a partial payment today for Invoice #4359 for $68,400. Our AR team split the wire between two corporate entities (Novus Health Inc. US and Novus Health Europe Ltd) and flagged tax IDs on the remittance, but our ERP requires credits to be posted to the corresponding legal entity and cost center lines. Can you confirm how Redwood will apply the partial payment across the two invoices/LEDGER entries?

Attached: bank receipt and remittance note.

What we need from you:
- Confirmation of which entity got credited and the per-line allocations Redwood will apply.
- Whether you can issue two credit memos (one per legal entity) or map the amounts to a single consolidated invoice with internal cost center tags so our AP can reconcile.
- VAT handling for the EU portion — Novus Health Europe Ltd is VAT-registered (VAT ID: EU123456789).

Thanks,
Sana Patel
Senior AR Manager
Novus Health

(Attachment: novus-bank-receipt-20260728.pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana@novushealth.io>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partial payment for invoice 4359 — routing across Novus entities

Thanks for the heads up, Sana — and thanks for the receipt. Looping in Ben (finance/collections) and Lauren (legal) to confirm the canonical approach.

Quick context for internal: Novus paid $68,400 against invoice 4359 (original total $102k). Their remittance indicates a $42,000 wire from the US entity and $26,400 from the EU entity. They want per-entity credit memos and cost center-level posting so their ERP reconciles cleanly.

Ben / Lauren — can we:
1) Generate two credit memos (US + EU) that sum to the payment amount?
2) Ensure the EU credit memo references VAT ID EU123456789 and indicates reverse-charge / VAT handling per standard EU SOW?
3) Provide a CSV or the remit-allocation-template.xlsx so Novus can reconcile easily on their side.

Sana — we will aim to respond with a proposed allocation table and the draft credit memos by end of day today.

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana@novushealth.io>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partial payment for invoice 4359 — routing across Novus entities

Jordan / Lauren / Sana — attaching the remit allocation template we use for multi-entity payments and a quick working table below.

Proposed allocation (working):
- Novus Health Inc. (US entity) — $42,000 — apply to Invoice 4359, lines 1-3 mapped to cost center CC-OPS-US
- Novus Health Europe Ltd (EU entity) — $26,400 — create separate credit memo referencing VAT ID EU123456789 and map to cost center CC-RD-EU

Notes / asks:
- For the EU amount we will zero-rate the VAT on our side if we have the VAT ID on the credit memo and the supply is treated under reverse charge. Lauren — can you confirm standard wording to include for audit trail?
- Do we want to issue two physical credit memo documents or one consolidated credit memo plus an internal ledger split? Customer asked explicitly for per-entity docs.

Next steps I propose:
1) Issue two credit memos (US doc + EU doc) and upload to customer portal.
2) Provide CSV with columns: invoice_number, entity, credited_amount, cost_center, tax_id, applied_date.
3) If Novus prefers one consolidated PDF, we can also include both memos in a single package but ledger entries must remain distinct.

Attachment: remit-allocation-template.xlsx

Ben Carter
Director, Finance — Receivables
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: remit-allocation-template.xlsx)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana@novushealth.io>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partial payment for invoice 4359 — routing across Novus entities

Ben — that plan sounds good. A couple of clarifications before you finalize:
- Please include cost center tags as free-form fields in the CSV (CC-OPS-US / CC-RD-EU) so their ERP can import.
- For audit purposes, include the original invoice lines being credited (line item IDs) in the CSV.
- Lauren — if the EU memo uses reverse-charge language, add the exact clause we should print (short text we can paste on the memo) so Novus has the required documentation.

Sana — will this satisfy your AP team's needs? If yes, Ben will issue two credit memos and send the CSV to you and your AR contact. If Novus prefers a single consolidated PDF package, confirm and we'll bundle both memos together.

Jordan
From: Novus Health AR <ar-team@novushealth.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partial payment for invoice 4359 — routing across Novus entities

Jordan / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming:
- We prefer two distinct credit memos (one for Novus Health Inc. US, one for Novus Health Europe Ltd) so our sub-ledgers remain clean.
- CSV with line-level mapping + cost center tags is perfect.
- VAT handling: confirm clause below is acceptable on the EU memo: "Supply of services subject to reverse charge — recipient liable for VAT per EU Directive; VAT ID EU123456789 provided."

We uploaded the bank receipt you requested (attached). Please proceed and we'll close the payment on our side once memos are available.

Thanks,
Sana Patel
Senior AR Manager
Novus Health
(Attachment: novus-bank-receipt-20260728.pdf)
